events.brand: NYS Daniel’s Law Coalition × community partners
events.what_it_is: A free community wellness day connecting New Yorkers with healthcare and mental-health resources, housing and food assistance, employment and education opportunities, legal services, holistic wellness resources, and family activities.
events.what_is_free: Admission and the community wellness programming are free and open to the public.
events.caveats: NAMI Queens/Nassau provides a registration action, while current event descriptions also state the event is free and open to the public. No organizer-approval or guest-list selection language was found. Classify the advertised registration path as Free RSVP rather than Approval Required.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 10 AM–2 PM. PS 16Q playground entrance is at 42nd Ave. & 104th St. in Corona, Queens.

occurrences.details: Free community wellness event. Registration is available through the NAMI Queens/Nassau event page; current descriptions also state it is free and open to the public.
